main_text.p: חבלא Ch. Corruptor, vastator, Exo. 4. 26. 27. in T. Jon.
חבול, חבל Ch. Væ, Hei, Deut. 28. 15. in Jon.
חבלא Chald. Funis, funiculus. Plur. חבלי, חבלין. Syr.
Cum Affix. ܚܒܠܝܗܝ Funes navis, Act. 27. 32.
חבלין Ch. & Syr. Dolores gravissimi, tormina, qualia sunt parturientium.
ܚܒܘܠܬܐ Syr. Idem. Plur. ܚܒܘܠܬܐ Usuræ, 1. ad Tim. 5. 4. Cū Aff. ܚܒܘܠܬܝ Usuras meas, 2. ad Cor. 6. 13.
מחבל, מחבלא Chal. Corruptor, vastator. Plur. מחבלין, מחבליא.
מחבלנא Chald. & Syr. Idem, Prov. 18. 9. 1. ad Cor. 10. 10.
ܚܒܠܘܬܐ Syr. Corruptio: ܚܒܠܘܬܐ ܒܠܝ Incorruptibilitas, 1. ad Cor. 15. 20. 2. ad Tim. 1. 10.
חבן ܚܒܘܢ Syr. Piger, Matth. 25. 26. Plural. ܚܒܘܢܝ Pigri, ad Rom. 12. 11.
ܚܒܝܢܘܬܐ Syr. חבינותא Ch. Pigritia, 1. ad Tim. 5. 13. Proverb. 31. 27.
חבן ܚܒܝ Syr. Premere, comprimere, Premendo contendere, Luc. 16. 16. Mar. 3. 9.
*חבק Ch. Amplecti, coplecti, amplexari. Pahel חבק Idē.

page.notes: Many Syriac and Hebrew words are damaged in the scan; the Syriac forms are approximate and marked as read from the print. Some Syriac vowel points are unclear. Marginal reference marks are small and not legible as separate notes.
